scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'test -z $EAS_BUILD$CI || exit 0; rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case $npm_config_user_agent in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo Use pnpm instead >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-nest run typecheck
scripts.check:api: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-nest run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-nest run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-nest run test && pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile run test
